_schema.description: One snapshot a day (Melbourne date) of each district's Australian Election Forecasts win probabilities and Sportsbet prices, kept for 35 days, so the weekly briefing card (home page, share/this-week.png) can show the seats that moved most over 7 days. Written by scripts/refresh.py from seat_models.json and seat_odds.json (backfilled from git history with --backfill-seat-history).

fields.days: {YYYY-MM-DD: {model_date, odds_date, seats: {district id: {model: {party code: win probability %}, odds: {party code: decimal price}}}}}; model probabilities under 0.5% and unnamed betting options ('Any Other') are left out
